title: Portfolio on Elastic Beanstalk
description: Built and deployed this portfolio as a stateless Python Flask app on AWS Elastic Beanstalk. Configured gunicorn as WSGI server, nginx as reverse proxy, and managed app versions via S3.

title: Static Website — S3 + CloudFront
description: Hosted a static website on Amazon S3 with CloudFront CDN for global delivery and HTTPS. Set up bucket policies and solved real-world errors including policy conflicts and Git auth issues.

title: EC2 Web Server — Nginx
description: Provisioned an EC2 t2.micro instance, configured Security Groups for HTTP/SSH, and deployed Nginx via SSH. Documented setup with a full troubleshooting guide.

title: Online Examination System
description: Led a team of three to design and build an online exam platform for educational institutions, focusing on efficiency, accessibility, and security in conducting assessments.

title: NDVI & Vegetation Health Analysis — Sentinel-2
short: Google Earth Engine · QGIS · Remote Sensing
description: Processed Sentinel-2 satellite imagery to compute NDVI and assess vegetation health across selected regions. Used Google Earth Engine and QGIS to generate raster outputs and interpret spatial patterns.

title: LiDAR Analysis for Forest Structure
description: Processed LiDAR point cloud data as part of the GIS in Forest Practice module at SGGW Warsaw to extract canopy height, tree density, and terrain models. Generated DEM, DSM, and CHM outputs using QGIS and LAStools.
